name: Takanezawa (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Takanezawa town emblem in white: a stylised bird-like device above a broken ring with a small disc.
history: Municipal flag of Takanezawa, a town in Tochigi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 25 December 1959.

features.role: Takanezawa town emblem — a stylised bird-like device above a broken ring with a small disc
